source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Purpose of Truth Tables (PDF 29, printed 25).

blocks.text: Truth tables ka asal maqsad yeh dikhana hai ke koi logical expression kaise behave karta hai (kab kya nateeja deta hai). In se pata chalta hai ke statement kab sach hai aur kab jhoot. Truth table tamam mumkin input values likhta hai, is liye reasoning mein uljhan door hoti hai. Truth tables se hum mushkil expressions aasani se check kar sakte hain aur mukhtalif statements ka muqabla (compare) kar sakte hain. Yeh faisla karne mein kaam aate hain aur logic aur computer science ke aham auzaar (tools) hain.

items: Truth table dikhata hai ke expression kab sach aur kab jhoot hai.
Saare inputs likhe hote hain, is liye uljhan nahi rehti aur statements compare ho sakte hain.
